Folks — forwarding Orion's ask (see below). Request is tight (need three references + quote by 2/18). Two quick constraints we should apply before I respond externally:

1) Reference respite rule: advocates should not be asked for more than 2 external reference engagements in a rolling 90-day window (call or written quote). That protects them from fatigue and reduces churn on the roster.
2) Cooling window exceptions: if an advocate is on an audit/P4 incident cadence or has a contract clause, we should mark them as "hold" until cleared.

Proposal: Offer Orion three options — (A) one live call + two written quotes, (B) three written quotes with one recorded audio clip, or (C) two live calls (short) but with substitute advocates available if anyone declines. I attached a proposed rotation matrix and our last-6-months contact log so you can see who we've used a lot.

If you approve, I'll:
- Check consent for BetaBank (Olivia) and Acme (they're on a sensitive deployment hold)
- Offer the three options and a calendar window for 2/18–2/20
- Provide a DocuSign NDA if required by the customer

Attachments: reference_rotation_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), last_6_months-contact-log.csv (csv)

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- BetaBank: Olivia is willing but they've asked that any public quote go through legal review. I'll loop in our legal ops if we need a written blurb.
- Acme: per their CS lead, they are under a PII audit until 3/31 and have explicitly asked not to be contacted for references until April. I'm attaching the consent PDF they sent (acme_consent.pdf) — it's basically a hold notice.
